> `Inspect a known node's outgoing targets for the requested label, making those
> targets available to read_node.`
rationale:
The requirement fixes one thing: the `outgoing_edges` MCP tool's description text. That text is "Inspect a known node's outgoing targets for the requested label, making those targets available to read_node."

In `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]`, the `outgoing_edges` entry's `"description"` is that same string, character for character. It is built into the `ToolDefinition` list that `tools` returns.

The only later change to that list is `tools.extend(self.tools.extra.definitions()?)` and the domain tools. The domain-tool loop rejects names that collide with existing tools, including `outgoing_edges`, so a domain tool cannot replace the description. The `{impl}` marker on this function is therefore correct.

I found no refining declarations and no `{fixme}` acknowledgments. I did not assess tests, because this is a structural assessment. The only other sites referencing this requirement's parent, `outgoing_edges.mcp`, are tests in `agent/tests.rs` and in `tools.rs#mod[tests]`.
